title: New Westin Hotel to Be Built at Rock Row in Westbrook, Maine - NewsBreak
text:
By Joey ,
5 hours ago
Tens of thousands of people regularly pour into the Rock Row development in Westbrook, Maine , on a daily basis.
Many of those people are visiting places like Market Basket, Chick-fil-a, Starbucks, Crumbl as well as Cowbell.
Phase I of the Rock Row development has clearly been a success. But so is phase II.
The Rock Row medical campus officially opened in April of 2025 . The medical campus has been humming along ever since.
Joe Dionne Now, it’s time for Rock Row to move onto their next phase which will include a lot of construction and a chance for many to stay and live at Rock Row.
Phase III at Rock Row in Westbrook, Maine, Will Include an Element By Westin Hotel A hotel featured at Rock Row in Westbrook, Maine, has always been part of the plan. What specific hotel had not been announced until now.
Element by Westin will be constructed at Rock Row . The 119-room hotel will be focused on wellness and have some interesting features.
Those include rooms that are meant for both short or long stays that include fully-equipped kitchens, large bathrooms as well as other home-like qualities.
Element hotels feature nature spaces for relaxation, a Bikes to Borrow program as well as complimentary breakfast.
Element hotels are also traditionally dog-friendly.
Phase III at Rock Row in Westbrook, Maine, Will Also Include Apartments and More Alongside the new Element by Westin hotel, phase III of the Rock Row development calls for 279 residential units as well .
Those units are planned to be a mixture of high-end apartments and townhomes that will be immersed in the Main Street experience at Rock Row.
Phase III will wrap up with over 136,000 square feet of commercial space that will bring new restaurants, retail and a movie theater to Rock Row.
The beginning construction stages for phase iii are already taking place with no firm timetable for completion as of this writing.
30 Places People Want to See at Rock Row in Westbrook, Maine Gallery Credit: Sean McKenna Getty Images Cheesecake Factory Cheesecake Factory tends to be a popular dream place for many Mainers as this restaurant has come up on a number of other lists involving things people want to come to Maine, including the Maine Mall . Getty Images Sonic Sonic is another long-requested restaurant from Mainers , but it's yet to come to Maine. Maybe Rock Row is the place? Getty Images Topgolf This popular golf driving range venue could be that alternative to all the golf courses in Maine . The next closest one is probably New York if you want to take the drive. Getty Images Nordstrom Who doesn't want to go shopping for new clothes at this department store chain? Getty Images P.F. Chang's If you're in the mood for some American-based Asian cuisine, this restaurant chain could be what you're looking for. Getty Images Hobby Lobby There are already a few in the state, but when you got to get your craft on, you got to get your craft on. Playa Bowls via Facebook Playa Bowls You can get acai, pitaya, coconut bowls and smoothies at Playa Bowls. There is at least one in Manchester, New Hampshire, and one in Hampton Beach, New Hampshire . Daves Hot Chicken via Facebook Dave's Hot Chicken Dave's Hot Chicken opened its second northeast location in Massachusetts in 2022, so what's one more? Getty Images Trader Joe's Sometimes you just need to go grocery shopping. Getty Images Dave & Buster's Time for some fun and games from this entertainment spot, right? Rainforest Cafe via Facebook Rainforest Cafe Wanting to eat and feel like you're in the jungle? Renys via Facebook Renys What's one more classic Maine store in Maine? Bring on Renys. Getty Images IKEA Time to put together some furniture. Getty Images Night Club for Dancing Sometimes you just really want to dance. How about a night club in Rock Row? Great Wolf Lodge via Facebook Great Wolf Lodge This popular indoor water park resort could bring those summer vibes when its freezing and snowy in a Maine winter. Getty Images Casino Place your bets on this one happening now. Getty Images Arby's There are only four in Maine at the moment: Auburn, Augusta, Presque Isle, and Topsham. Getty Images Indoor Pool Again, when you just need a taste of summer in the winter. Let's go for a swim! Getty Images Williams Sonoma There used to be one in the Maine Mall... Canva Drive-In Restaurant Bringing the old school vibes, a drive-in restaurant where you enjoy a meal in your car could hit the spot. Getty Images Indoor Play Area for Kids Kids need a place to run around and get their energy out, right? Getty Images Dog Park Imagine a wide-open space perfect for all the pups to play. Getty Images Shake Shack This fast-casual restaurant is based in New York, but let's dream about it coming to Rock Row. Getty Images Concerts There once was a venue for concerts at Rock Row, but sadly, no shows for the future at Rock Row . Maybe something will change and we get music back to the Westbrook area. Getty Images Train Station Forget getting to Rock Row by car or bus. A train would be nice. Getty Images Brewery/Distillery Maine has a bunch of breweries, including many under-the-radar ones , so why not get one at Rock Row. Getty Images Steakhouse Maybe a chain like Longhorn? Maybe something that screams local? Whatever it is, let the steak be delicious. Jimmy John's via Facebook Jimmy John's This sandwich spot is in Massachusetts... so why not Maine? Getty Images A Non-Chain Restaurant Forget the chains! Bring in something local or a one-of-a-kind restaurant straight from Maine. Getty Images Indoor Soccer Complex People must be still feeling those World Cup vibes. 7 New Maine Restaurants That Opened in March 2026 Gallery Credit: Sean McKenna Mad Kat's Restaurant via Facebook Mad Kat's Restaurant Mad Kat's Restaurant opened in Brewer, Maine, on March 4, 2026. Mad Kat's Restaurant via Facebook Mad Kat's Restaurant According to WABI , the restaurant first opened in March 2021, closed in 2024, got new ownership in April 2025 and then closed in November 2025 with the loss of a liquor license.
The news station reported that the original owners are back, the restaurant has new renovations, and there's a hope it will be a community karaoke spot again. nomadowlshead via Instagram Nomad Nomad opened in Owls Head, Maine, on March 5, 2026. nomadowlshead via Instagram Nomad According to the Pen Bay Pilot, Nomad, located in the Knox County Regional Airport, is a rebrand from the original restaurant called The Apron.
The news outlet reported that the focus for now will be on handmade pastries and baked goods in a slow roll out that will later introduce more menu items. Day Boat Cafe via Facebook Day Boat Cafe Day Boat Cafe opened in Waldoboro, Maine, on March 18, 2026. Day Boat Cafe via Facebook Day Boat Cafe According to its website , Day Boat Cafe offers "a menu of hearty sandwiches, wholesome soups, fresh salads, baked goods, and a variety of take-away meal options." playmakerspizza via Instagram Playmakers Pizza & Pub Playmakers Pizza and Pub opened in Portland, Maine, on March 18, 2026. playmakerspizza via Instagram Playmakers Pizza & Pub According to its website , Playmakers Pizza & Pub will feature pizza, wings, and drinks in a "family-friendly dining area, and with a sports bar loaded with TVs." y.f_portland via Instagram Y%F Y%F opened in Portland, Maine, on March 20, 2026. y.f_portland via Instagram Y%F According to its website , Y%F "blends personal heritage with the heart of coffee culture." The Maine Mall via Facebook Aromas of India Aromas of India opened in South Portland, Maine, on March 27, 2026. The Maine Mall via Facebook Aromas of India Aromas of India is located inside the Maine Mall, and according to its Instagram page , it offers "authentic Indian flavors." sundancesignco via Instagram York Street Kitchen York Street Kitchen opened in York, Maine, on March 28, 2026. Yorkstreetkitchen via Facebook York Street Kitchen According to its Facebook page , York Street Kitchen is "a small local eatery featuring scratch cooking and fresh sourdough breads."
